# SCI-NOI v0.1 r0.5 Conditional UNC-Realization Amendment

Scientific owner: Grant Wilson. Date: 2026-08-30. Status: proposed final; not
frozen.

For the initial base method, set/count equality is a consequence of realization:

`initial_UNC_realized` implies `A_UNC=B_resolved` and
`N_admitted=N_completed=N_resolved=N_requested>0`.

On that state, every resolved member completes, passes the assignment-ignorable
member policy, belongs to the common all-member domain, and enters
`Vhat_cond=(1/N_resolved) sum_{b in B_resolved} M_b^2`. One ineligible,
unavailable, incomplete, failed, or unrealized member makes the complete
initial estimator unavailable. There is no survivor subset, renormalization,
or divisor change.

When initial UNC is failed or unavailable, actual requested, resolved,
completed, and admitted counts remain factual and may be unequal. Member and
ensemble causes remain published, while no estimator or changed divisor exists.

A future subset, pairwise, missing-data, survivor, or reweighted estimator has
a different method identity, target law, selection model, and normalized
weights. D-010, EQ-009/010, REQ-024/025, and PRED-019 carry this closure.
